latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release.
This ClawHub package provides the publish-safe text version of CLI Agent Bridge for OpenClaw.
It includes skill rules, approval model, filesystem operation guidance, and local setup instructions.
Known limitations: full execution capabilities depend on local runtime components and installation environment.
